sources_used: location.am-all.net maimai DX International NZ (gm=98, ct=1014)
web search (venue names + rhythm game terms)

findings.name: Bowlarama @ Wellington
findings.evidence_quote: ZIv game list (updated 2025-12-15) is only non-music cabs: Temple Run 2, Batman x2, Battle Gear 3, Sega Rally 2, Big Buck Safari, Ghost Squad, Silent Scope, Time Crisis 4, Barbercut, Deal or No Deal. No music/rhythm games listed.
findings.note: Bowling/laser/gellyball FEC with PrizeZone-style token arcade. Website describes racers, shooters, claws, redemption only. No rhythm evidence on site or ZIv.

findings.name: Coin Singing Booth
findings.evidence_quote: maimai FiNALE (Japan) - Modded Chinese/舞萌 cab, running finale dump. Gloves provided, $2.5 for 3 songs single or 4 songs double. Instagram: Come visit us and play Maimai finale.
findings.note: Karaoke booth shop with offline maimai FiNALE (not ALL.Net DX). Mapped to maimai_dx as only maimai slug. Not on official maimai DX International NZ locator.

findings.name: Dropzone
findings.evidence_quote: Dance Central 3 (International) - Weird Xbox 360 Kinect arcade cab. Condition: Perfect. Also Batman cabs.
findings.note: Taupo trampoline/bowling FEC. Dance Central 3 is Kinect dance, not a core bemani title; slug other. No maimai/DDR/etc. evidence.

findings.name: Galaxy Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Enjoy retro games such as Donkey Kong and Street Fighter, console games, darts, pool, board games galore. Grab a VR headset and kick ZOMBIE BUT!
findings.note: Freeplay retro bar/arcade. Site and ZIv list classics only; no bemani/rhythm titles found. ZIv has empty game list.

findings.name: Game Over @ Auckland
findings.evidence_quote: We have packed our venue with arcade games galore! Step into our arcade and immerse yourself in a world of pixelated adventures and nostalgic thrills... Rack up points and then head over to select a prize!
findings.note: Go-karts/laser/minigolf FEC with redemption arcade. No game list naming rhythm titles. Not on ALL.Net NZ maimai list. ZIv empty.

findings.name: Game Over @ Queenstown
findings.evidence_quote: Games: No games at this location. Sister brand to Game Over Auckland (karts/laser/FEC arcade).
findings.note: No public machine list found; no rhythm evidence. Unknown rather than confirmed_none.

findings.name: Jagotown
findings.evidence_quote: Jago Town is an indoor playground at Te Awa... explore jungle-themed activities, race down exciting slides. Shop M03, Te Awa Mall, The Base Hamilton.
findings.note: Kids soft-play indoor playground, not a music arcade. Same mall as Timezone The Base (which has maimai) but different tenant. Do not attach Timezone games.

findings.name: Leap Indoor Trampoline Park
findings.evidence_quote: Picture titled DDR X3vs2ndMix and DM V8. Comment (Hamlegstuff, ~1 year ago): rip to ddr x3 and dm v8 they went to auckland. Current Games: No games at this location.
findings.note: Had DDR X3 and DrumMania V8; community says they moved to Auckland. Current floor unlisted. Not has_games; not certain confirmed_none for remaining small arcade.

findings.name: Lilliputt Fun Zone
findings.evidence_quote: Games listed: Mario Kart Arcade GP DX; Wangan Midnight Maximum Tune 6RR. Family entertainment centre with minigolf arcade games laser tag vr - the arcade games are eh.
findings.note: Racing-only listing on ZIv; no music/rhythm cabs reported. Racing/redemption FEC, not rhythm.

findings.name: Live Wire @ Sylvia Park Auckland
findings.evidence_quote: Mario Kart Arcade GP DX; Super Bikes 3; Wangan Midnight MAXIMUM TUNE 6; Big Buck Hunter: Reloaded; Space Invaders Frenzy. Updated 2025-11-23.
findings.note: Documented floor is racers/shooters only. Not on ALL.Net NZ maimai list.

findings.name: Megastrike
findings.evidence_quote: Lots of redemption games. Games: No games at this location.
findings.note: Pukekohe bowls/club entertainment; redemption-heavy. No rhythm evidence found; not strong enough for confirmed_none.

findings.name: Megazone @ Dunedin
findings.evidence_quote: mostly redemption games. Offers Laser Tag, Minigolf, Axe Throwing and VR. Games: No games at this location.
findings.note: Laser tag FEC with redemption arcade; no named rhythm cabs found.

findings.name: Megazone @ Silverdale
findings.evidence_quote: has arcade games, pixel grid and flight sims. Only listed game: Cruis'n Blast.
findings.note: Standalone Megazone; only non-music racing cab listed. No rhythm evidence.

findings.name: Newmarket Tenpin Bowling
findings.evidence_quote: As of the 12th of August 2017 there is now a Beatmania IIDX machine here... Update: 24/3/2025 IIDX has been updated to IIDX 31: EPOLIS. Games table still lists Guitar Hero Arcade. Pictures include Beatmania IIDX, openITG, IIDX and Jubeat.
findings.note: IIDX not currently in ZIv Games table but owner update through 2025-03-24 still present in page info as of 2026-01-28 edit; confidence likely not certain. Guitar Hero Arcade = other (not gitadora). Historical openITG/jubeat photos may be outdated; not asserted as current.

findings.name: Oddyseum Queenstown
findings.evidence_quote: The only Freeplay arcade in New Zealand... Games: TMNT Turtles In Time, Mortal Kombat II, Street Fighter II, Ms. Pac-Man, Pac-Man, Big Buck World, Terminator 2, Galaga, Golden Tee Golf, NBA Jam.
findings.note: Odysseum Arcadium freeplay retro room. Full ZIv list is fighters/classics only; no rhythm.

findings.name: PLAY @ Event Cinemas Tauranga
findings.evidence_quote: Smallest PLAY arcade in nz, no rhythm games.
findings.note: Positive ZIv visitor statement of no rhythm games at this cinema lobby PLAY.

findings.name: Play2Win @ Cloud9 Palmerston North
findings.evidence_quote: small arcade area downstairs. Only listed game: Mario Kart Arcade GP DX.
findings.note: Redemption/Play2Win floor; only MK listed. Timezone Palmerston Square (separate) has maimai on ALL.Net; do not attach.

findings.name: Play2Win @ New Plymouth
findings.evidence_quote: Games: No games at this location. No website or machine list beyond ZIv stub.
findings.note: Chain redemption arcade type; no rhythm proof either way.

findings.name: Player1
findings.evidence_quote: Very new small arcade as of May 12th 2026. Dance Live (International) $3 / 3 Songs, Perfect.
findings.note: Dance Live is a Chinese dance-rhythm cabinet; not dance_around/DDR. Slug other.

findings.name: PrizeZone @ The Palms Shirley
findings.evidence_quote: (Formerly Oasis), PrizeZone mostly has claw machines, you can purchase either a card or tokens. Games: No games at this location.
findings.note: Mall prize/claw zone; positive claw-only description. No rhythm evidence.

findings.name: PrizeZone @ Velocity Entertainment
findings.evidence_quote: Uses different cards to the prior one in palmy and the one in chch... Games: No games at this location.
findings.note: PrizeZone at Velocity Hastings. No machine inventory found; chain is typically claw/redemption but not asserted.

findings.name: Quickplay @ Ormiston
findings.evidence_quote: In the Groove 2 (North America) - Comment: DDR Classic cab running ITG3 Encore, All DDR songs 1stMIX - A20+ are playable. Two USB Drive slots for Custom Charts. 3 Tokens / 2 Songs, Perfect. Updated 2026-07-03.
findings.note: ITG/OpenITG-style pad on DDR shell; not official DDR or StepManiaX product. Slug other. QuickPlay chain also at other Auckland sites; this sid is Ormiston.

findings.name: Rainbow's End
findings.evidence_quote: NZs largest theme park... IIRC I think it's $10 just to play in the arcade. Games: No games at this location.
findings.note: Theme park arcade unlisted. Not on ALL.Net NZ maimai (Zone Manukau is nearby separate). No rhythm inventory found.

findings.name: Reading Cinemas Porirua
findings.evidence_quote: Small arcade in the lobby outside the theaters... SEGA Racing Classic; Wangan Midnight MAXIMUM TUNE 3 DX PLUS (2P); Deadstorm Pirates Special Edition.
findings.note: Cinema lobby: racers and gun only. No music games listed.

findings.name: Retrobowl
findings.evidence_quote: Previously known as Superbowl, located in Dunedin [address is Invercargill], uses cards. Games: No games at this location.
findings.note: Bowling with card arcade; no machine list online. ZIv info text confuses Dunedin vs Invercargill address.

findings.name: Strike Entertainment Centre
findings.evidence_quote: Has lots of redemption games, apparently is trying to get a DDR cab. Dance Live (International) $3.50 / 3 Songs, Moderate. Mario Kart Arcade GP turned off as of 10/11/25.
findings.note: Dance Live present. DDR only aspirational (not installed). Lower Hutt bowling/laser/arcade.

findings.name: Superstrike
findings.evidence_quote: Bowling alley with pool tables and a small arcade section. Uses $2 coins. Games: No games at this location.
findings.note: Small unlisted arcade; no rhythm evidence found.

findings.name: Tenpin Tauranga
findings.evidence_quote: Cyber Cycles; Daytona USA 2; OutRun; Scud Race; Time Crisis II. Updated 2025-11-23. No music games listed.
findings.note: Bowling + racers/guns; Chinese knock-offs noted. No rhythm cabs on ZIv list.

findings.name: The Lanes
findings.evidence_quote: Bowling alley with lots of pinball cabs and a few arcade games. Street Fighter II CE; Street Fighter III New Generation; Multicade; Point Blank.
findings.note: Pinball + fighters/guns only; no rhythm.

findings.name: Ye Olde Pinball Shoppe
findings.evidence_quote: New Zealand's Only Dedicated Pinball Arcade... play over twenty unique pinball machines under one roof. ZIv lists Godzilla (Stern), Pokemon (Pro), Pulp Fiction, The Mandalorian pinball only.
findings.note: Dedicated pinball bar; positive pinball-only positioning.

findings.name: ZONE Bowling @ Garden City
findings.evidence_quote: Has no RGs or Wangan so hesitant to add but very fun for redemption games.
findings.note: Visitor explicitly: no rhythm games. ALL.Net NZ maimai lists Zone Manukau and Zone Botany only, not Garden City Christchurch.

findings.name: Arcade @ Dream Park and Gardems
findings.evidence_quote: This arcade has access to a Dance Central 3 cabinet. Games: Dance Central 3 Perfect.
findings.note: Nigeria Ikorodu. ZIv entry last updated 2021; no newer confirmation found. Dance Central = other. Stale date => unverified.

findings.name: Arcade @ Elegante Mall
findings.evidence_quote: E5 Dance Super Station (China) - Comment: 2 cabinets of this game available at this arcade. TikTok evidence linked. PLEASE NOTE THAT THIS ARCADE IS NOT IN SOUTH AFRICA, IT IS LOCATED IN NIGERIA!!
findings.note: Abuja Elegante Mall. Chinese Dance Super Station pads (not DDR/PIU). Count 2 stated on ZIv.

findings.name: Arcade @ Silverbird Cimena Abuja
findings.evidence_quote: This arcade has access to a 3-DDX arcade cabinet. Games: 3-DDX / D-Tech Perfect. Picture uploaded.
findings.note: Silverbird Cinema Abuja (typo Cimena in name). 3DDX is Korean motion dance; slug other. 2021 data only.

findings.name: Arcade @ Sweet Sensation
findings.evidence_quote: This arcade has access to a Dance Central 3 arcade cabinet. Games: Dance Central 3 Perfect. Picture uploaded.
findings.note: Ikeja Lagos. 2021 ZIv only; no 2024-2026 reconfirm. Dance Central = other.

findings.name: Crusifix Games and Lounge
findings.evidence_quote: Page title: Crusifix Games and Lounge CLOSED. Comment SAE_1949 2026-08-02: Location marked as closed. Had bootleg soft dance pad historically.
findings.note: Surulere Lagos. ZIv marked closed 2026-08-02. Soft pad was never a classified music game on ZIv games table.

findings.name: Froggles Play Zone Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: This arcade has access to a Dance Central 3 cabinet. Games: Dance Central 3 Perfect. Two pictures.
findings.note: Lekki Lagos. 2021 ZIv only. Dance Central = other.

findings.name: Play Zone @ Lennox Mall
findings.evidence_quote: This arcade has access to a Dance Central 3 arcade cabinet. Games: Dance Central 3 Perfect.
findings.note: Lennox Mall Lekki. Oldest Nigeria entry (2020); no newer evidence. Dance Central = other.

findings.name: Bowling1 Drammen
findings.evidence_quote: Bowling, Megazone laserspill, biljard, underholdningsspill. ZIv (2015): Ghost Squad Evolution; Pool Table only. No music games listed.
findings.note: Active bowling/laser center. ZIv cab list 11 years stale. Website does not name rhythm games; absence is not confirmed_none given stale inventory.
